title: Quasinormal modes of coupled metric-dilaton perturbations in two-dimensional stringy black holes
summary: We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) associated with intrinsic metric-dilaton coupled perturbations of the Mandal-Sengupta-Wadia (MSW) black hole in two-dimensional string theory. Through suitable field redefinitions, the gravity-dilaton system is expressed in terms of the conformal factor and a redefined dilaton field, allowing the linear perturbation equations to be reduced to coupled Schrodinger-type eigenvalue equations in the tortoise coordinate.
